title: Stress and Fuzz Boundary Policy
purpose: Strict policy for fuzz, proptest, and stress evidence over parser and untrusted-input trust boundaries. This policy treats boundary fidelity as the requirement, not merely the existence of fuzz targets or stress scripts.

audit_context.governance_note: The audit found useful fuzz/proptest infrastructure, but missing machine mapping from trust boundaries to fuzz/property/stress evidence and under-fidelity in scheduled stress flows.

delegates.scope: General Rust testing expectations and property/fuzz requirement statement. This policy owns the machine-readable boundary mapping.
Shared review-artifact discovery, line limits, and strict validator execution.
Release-critical use of stress/fuzz results as a signing gate.

field_semantics.id: Stable lowercase identifier, unique across all parser-boundary registry files.
field_semantics.kind: One of parser, subprocess-output, file-load, filename, markdown-preview, diff, project-tree, save-reload, generated-ui-flow, or other-reviewed-boundary.
field_semantics.source_paths: Repo-relative files or globs containing the boundary implementation.
field_semantics.entrypoints: Functions, binaries, scripts, UI flows, or subprocess commands where untrusted data enters the boundary.
field_semantics.real_input_shape: Concrete wire/file/UI/subprocess shape that production accepts, including delimiters, encodings, size limits, and source of bytes.
field_semantics.coverage: Array of fuzz, proptest, unit, integration, Flatpak, or stress evidence entries with repo paths and target names.
field_semantics.gaps: Known missing cases; each must be empty or linked to planned_remediation or reviewed_exceptions.
field_semantics.reviewed_exceptions: Input shapes or trust-boundary cases intentionally not fuzzed/stressed and backed by review evidence; this is not reviewer approval metadata.
field_semantics.last_reviewed: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date from day one.

git_status_parse.real_shape: git status --porcelain=v2 -z output: NUL-delimited records, control fields, ordinary paths, unmerged entries, control-character paths, and non-UTF-8 path bytes.

markdown_parse.real_shape: UTF-8 or replacement-decoded document text after SourceView file loading and Riteed document limits, including CommonMark, frontmatter-adjacent text, code fences, images, links, and literal HTML.

frontmatter_split.real_shape: Markdown file start bytes and decoded text with YAML-style delimiters, malformed delimiters, and body transitions.

diff_compute.real_shape: Line-oriented editor and Git comparison text, including large line counts, empty files, binary-adjacent replacement text, and control characters.

unsupported_scanner.real_shape: Markdown source bytes containing HTML, image/link targets, unsupported syntax, and malformed UTF-8 after app decoding.

page_text_decode.real_shape: An eight-byte little-endian u64 file offset followed by arbitrary paged document bytes, including empty payloads and split UTF-8 sequences.

field_semantics.finding_id: Stable audit or policy finding identifier, for example RIT-AUD-001.
field_semantics.target_milestone: Milestone expected to clear or re-authorize the entry.
field_semantics.review_artifact: Repo-relative evidence path that will prove closure or intentional deferral.
field_semantics.created: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date. The validator evaluates created + max_age_days against current UTC date.
field_semantics.max_age_days: Positive integer. Expired remediation is a hard failure.
field_semantics.reason: Specific current gap; prose-only TODOs are not allowed.
field_semantics.removal_condition: Concrete machine or review evidence that clears the entry.
field_semantics.approval_required: Optional free-form approver identifier such as a GitHub team, role, or individual.

registry_checks: parser-boundary JSON files exist and have unique ids
each source_path exists or expands to at least one file
coverage entries point to existing fuzz targets, tests, or stress scripts
gaps are empty or linked to planned remediation/reviewed exception
last_reviewed and reviewed_exception dates use YYYY-MM-DD
fuzz_checks: required fuzz targets have exact Cargo bin registrations
each target has a seed corpus
git_status_parse seeds contain NUL-delimited porcelain v2 examples
page_text_decode seeds cover every policy-owned offset and byte-shape class
scheduled/manual stress invokes every required fuzz target through cargo-fuzz
app/fuzz/Cargo.lock stays synchronized with app/Cargo.lock via dependency preflight
stress_checks: stress scripts satisfy the declared schema
runner consumes declared fixtures rather than creating unrelated temp-only inputs for named boundary flows
scheduled/manual stress invokes corpus and Git repo generators before running scripts
failure artifacts include stress and fuzz reproducer directories
planned_remediation_checks: created dates are valid ISO dates
review_artifact paths exist unless the entry explicitly creates that artifact
